description: This file defines the RDKShell class and related structures for managing shell operations, events, and interactions within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes method declarations, event definitions, and internal class structures for handling application lifecycle, system events, and screen capture functionalities.

classes.name: RDKShell
classes.description: Main class providing shell management, event handling, and system interaction functionalities within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: RdkShellListener
classes.description: Listener class for handling RDKShell application events such as launch, suspend, resume, and focus changes.

classes.name: MonitorClients
classes.description: Class implementing plugin notification interfaces to monitor client plugin lifecycle events.

classes.name: ScreenCapture
classes.description: Class implementing screen capture functionality, allowing image data to be captured and stored.

classes.name: TaskQueue
classes.description: Thread-safe queue for managing asynchronous tasks related to shell operations.

classes.name: PluginData
classes.description: Structure holding plugin class name information.

classes.name: PluginStateChangeData
classes.description: Class managing plugin state change events and connection resets.

methods.name: launchRequestThread
methods.description: Launch a thread to process RDKShell API requests.

methods.description: Send a client to the back of the Z-order.

methods.name: moveBehind

methods.name: setFocus
methods.description: Set focus to a specific client.

methods.description: Add a key intercept for specific key codes and modifiers.

methods.description: Add key event listeners for a client.

methods.name: removeKeyListeners

methods.name: injectKey
methods.description: Inject a key event into the system.

methods.name: generateKey
methods.description: Generate a key sequence for a client.

methods.name: createDisplay
methods.description: Create a new display for a client.

methods.name: getVisibility
methods.description: Get visibility status of a client.

methods.name: getOpacity
methods.description: Get opacity level of a client.

methods.name: setOpacity

methods.name: getScale
methods.description: Get scale factors of a client.

methods.name: setScale

methods.name: getHolePunch
methods.description: Get hole punch status of a client.

methods.name: setHolePunch
methods.description: Set hole punch status of a client.

methods.name: checkForBootupFactoryAppLaunch
methods.description: Check if factory app should launch on boot.

methods.name: getKeyRepeatsEnabled
methods.description: Check if key repeats are enabled.

methods.name: getVirtualResolution
methods.description: Get virtual resolution of a client.

methods.name: setVirtualResolution

methods.description: Get list of blocked AV applications.
